title: Gluten-Free Cornbread
description: A warm and comforting cornbread that is perfect for any meal. Made with gluten-free flours and fresh corn.
instructions: Grease an 8-inch square baking dish with butter or cooking spray.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, cornmeal, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the melted butter, egg, and buttermilk.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Fold in the frozen corn kernels.
Pour the batter into the prepared baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
